svg.aria-label: How the four TrustLens repositories fit together: the web app calls the backend, the backend reads Base and an AI triage API, a keep-warm cron pings the backend every ten minutes, and the contracts sit dark while the product is in free beta.
svg.title: The four repositories
svg.desc: trustlens-web is a static Vite bundle on Cloudflare that posts to trustlens-backend, a FastAPI service on Render that runs Slither and an AI triage pass. The backend reads verified source and proxy storage slots from Base. trustlens-keepwarm is a scheduled GitHub Action that curls the backend health endpoint every ten minutes so the free tier does not sleep. trustlens-contracts holds PaymentGate on Base Sepolia; both dashed payment paths are switched off while FREE_BETA is on.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four repositories. One of them is switched off on purpose.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Solid arrows are what runs today. The dashed ones are the payment path: written, tested, deployed to Base Sepolia, and dark while the scanner is free.

svg.text: The keep-warm cron exists because Render's free tier sleeps after fifteen minutes and a cold start is the worst first impression a scanner can make.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: GitHub disables a scheduled workflow after sixty days with no pushes to its repo, and the cron itself does not count as a push. Only a commit re-arms it.
